description: This file defines a registration page component for a Tictac-Toe game platform frontend, handling user registration with form inputs, state management, API interaction, and navigation.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Creates a Qwik component that renders the registration form and manages its state.

methods.name: performRegister
methods.description: Asynchronous event handler that submits registration data, processes response, updates state, and redirects upon success.
